featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-128-NDI-TRX is a high-performance gateway that bridges NDI and NetworkHD ecosystems with seamless bidirectional conversion. Designed for flexibility, it allows up to 8 NDI streams to be converted into NetworkHD transmitters, while simultaneously outputting one NHD channel to NDI for integration with platforms such as Microsoft Teams, OBS, or vMix.

Compact and PoE-powered, the NHD-128-NDI-TRX simplifies deployment and reduces system complexity by replacing multiple converters with a single, all-in-one device. The device is fully compatible with WyreStorm Sygma Cloud, enabling remote monitoring, firmware updates, and proactive management from anywhere.
Perfect for digital courtrooms, lecture halls, and corporate AV environments, this gateway enables unified workflows where NDI and NHD coexist effortlessly.
Easily integrate up to eight NDI HX (NDI 6) camera streams into the NetworkHD system, allowing NDI sources to function as virtual NHD transmitters for flexible multi-camera installations.

NDI main stream in: up to 4K@30Hz, up to 16Mbps; out up to 20Mbps

network: RJ45 for both stream input and output

physical: 1/8 rack width, wall or rack mountable
dependencies: Documented compatible with NHD-100, NHD-120 and NHD-150 series only

checks: Compatibility is documented for the NHD-100, 120 and 150 series. It is NOT listed as compatible with the 500 or 600 series - confirm before designing it into a 500/600 system.
Maximum is 4K@30Hz on both NDI and NHD paths. Confirm against any 4K60 requirement.
This is a stream gateway with no HDMI connectors - it converts between NDI and NetworkHD on the network, and does not take a local source.
warnings: Has no HDMI ports at all. Both its input and output are network streams, so it cannot accept a local HDMI source or drive a display directly.
The specification table states 20V DC 1A and PoE, while the feature list states PoE 802.3af. Confirm the required PoE class before relying on switch power.
